tr: Wa ḥaqqiq bi hā rūhī li’aẓfara bi ‘l-munā
en: By their secrets condition my inward and out – Actualize by them my soul so I obtain my desire

ar: وَ قَوِّ بِهَا ذَوْقِيْ وَلَمْسِيْ وَعَقْلَنَا
tr: Wa nawwir bi hā sam`ī wa shammī wa nāẓirī
Wa qawwi bi hā dhawqī wa lamsī wa `aqlanā.
en: Illuminate by them my hearing, smelling and seeing – Strengthen by them my taste, touch and our consciousness.

tr: Wa yassir bi hā amrī wa qawwi `azā’imī
Wa zakki bi hā nafsī wa farrij kurūbanā
en: Ease by them my affair and strengthen my resolve – Purify by them my self and dispel our concerns.

ar: وَ وَسِّعْ بِهَا عِلْمِيْ وَرِزْقِيْ وَهِمَّتِيْ
وَحَسِّنْ بِهَا خَلْقِيْ وَخُلُقِيْ مَعَ الْهَنَا
tr: Wa wassi` bi hā `ilmī wa rizqī wa himmatī
Wa ḥassin bi hā khalqī wa khuluqī ma`a ‘l-hanā
en: Expand by them my knowledge, sustainance and aspiration – Beautify by them my form and character with pleasure.

ar: وَ هَبْ لِيْ بِهَا حُبًّا جَلِيْلًا مُجَمَّلًا
tr: Wa hab lī bi hā ḥubban jalīlan mujammalā
Wa zid nī bi farṭi ‘l-ḥubbi fīka tafannunā
en: Bestow upon me by them beautified supreme love –Increase me in excessive love for You, annihilating us.
blocks.review: تَفَنُّن: printed ending in a bare final nūn with no visible vowel and no alif, although the transliteration reads tafannunā; transcribed as printed. Proof-read: confirmed — final nūn printed bare (shadda+ḍamma sit on the middle nūn only).
